# Junior Software Engineer — Dayton, OH (on site), full-time

You will be our first in-house software engineer, reporting to the Operations Director.
Responsibilities: automate order intake from email and the customer portal into our production schedule; build internal reports; maintain the portal's integrations; support the colleagues who use these tools every day.
Required: Python; SQL; working directly with non-technical colleagues.
Preferred: REST APIs; Microsoft Power Automate.
